### macOS display wake reliability

- Before changing the shared monitor input, DisplayMux now asks the destination Mac to activate its display output through the authenticated local Agent.
- The Mac keeps a user-activity and display-sleep assertion active for 30 seconds, preventing the lock screen from turning black again during the two-second signal stabilization wait.
- If the display wake assertion cannot be started, DisplayMux stops before changing the monitor input to avoid switching to a blank signal.

### Compatibility

- Supports Windows 10/11 and macOS 12 or later.
- Existing settings are preserved when updating from v0.1.7.

### Known limitations

- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may require manual approval.
- Some MST, DisplayLink, and Silicon Motion docks do not forward DDC/CI. Software cannot restore control signals that the hardware does not expose.
